hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.kt ]] || [[ "$file" == *.java ]] || [[ "$file" == *.go ]]; then echo '[Advisory] Remember to run build after changes: ./gradlew build (Kotlin/Java) or make build (Go)'; fi

cmd="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; if [[ "$cmd" == *gradlew* ]] || [[ "$cmd" == *"make build"* ]] || [[ "$cmd" == *"go test"* ]]; then echo '[Advisory] Consider using background mode (run_in_background) for long-running commands'; fi
file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.kt ]]; then echo '[Advisory] Run ./gradlew spotlessApply to format Kotlin code'; fi

file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.kt ]] || [[ "$file" == *.java ]]; then if grep -q 'println\|System.out' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo '[Advisory] Found println/System.out statements. Consider using proper logging (SLF4J/Logback)'; fi; elif [[ "$file" == *.go ]]; then if grep -q 'fmt.Print' "$file" 2>/dev/null; then echo '[Advisory] Found fmt.Print statements. Consider using proper logging'; fi; fi
echo '[Advisory] Session ending. Remember to check for debug statements (println, System.out, fmt.Print) before committing.'
